title: Warp Tunnel
description: Rings rushing out of the dark: a hyperspace tunnel in pure CSS, no script at all.
usage: Twelve rings, one keyframe, staggered delays — the cheapest speed in the catalog. Drop it behind a launch headline when the message is "fast" and the meeting is short. It is the only KATAYABURI part with no JavaScript, which the shelf finds hilarious.
a11y: Decoration with a strong motion signature: under prefers-reduced-motion the rings freeze into a target — still pretty, entirely honest. Never put the only copy of a message inside the tunnel; text rides above it or not at all.
